_README: Reserved dead event types: declared (or data-seeded) but never emitted from a real emitter script. Keys are PDV_EventTypes.<EVT_NAME> for declared constants and PDV_EventTypes.ID_<id> for data-seeded ids with no (live) declaration. The EVT emission coverage gate (tools/pdv_signal_e2e_gate.mjs) reports a listed key as a documented KNOWN-GAP; any dead event NOT listed FAILs, and a stale entry (now emitted / no longer present) FAILs. Verdicts per the 2026-07-07 owner grill session. Delete an entry when its verdict lands.

PDV_EventTypes.EVT_HEAL_OR_CURE_NPC.reason: SPEC INVALID, needs redesign (2026-08-12): the 2026-07-07 emitter spec (OnMagicEffectApplyEx, player-cast restore/cure on a friendly NPC) cannot work. PO3 OnMagicEffectApplyEx is TARGET-side -- the player alias only hears effects applied TO the player (see the note at PDV_PlayerEvents.psc OnMagicEffectApplyEx), so a heal the player casts on ANOTHER actor never reaches it. OnSpellCast is caster-side but carries no target, so self-heal cannot be excluded and 'healed an NPC' cannot be confirmed. No clean caster+target hook exists; a real 350 detector needs a new approach (e.g. a scripted restore/cure MGEF that reports its own caster+target). Remains RESERVED. Original 2026-07-07 verdict was WIRE post-mega-packet: 19 deity rows incl. a two-sided Boethiah/Sithis/Mephala-dislike axis.

PDV_EventTypes.EVT_VAMPIRE_FEED.reason: WIRE post-mega-packet (owner 2026-07-07): Molag Bal signature row (+0.5), plus Mephala patron +0.35 and Azura -1.0. VIABLE APPROACH (2026-08-12): the feed effect lands ON the player, so PO3 OnMagicEffectApplyEx (TARGET-side) can catch it -- register the vanilla/Dawnguard feed MGEF(s) in a new FormList (mirror PDV_FLST_Altmer_Syrabane_CureEffects wiring) and HasListedForm-match in the handler. Needs: identify the feed MGEF(s), an ESP FormList + filled alias property (fresh save to bind), and in-game validation. Blocked only on that ESP+validation work, not on a missing hook.
